  {"Resume exporting"} <MarkerAddedInVersion version="8.10" />{" "}

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/exporting/resume"}
  context={"endpoint"}
></MethodEndpoint>

<MarkerStronglyConsistentExtension />

Resumes exporting on all partitions of the physical tenant after a pause or soft pause.

<MarkerRequiredPermissions
  permissions={[{ resourceType: "EXPORTER", permissionType: "PAUSE" }]}
/>

<ParamsDetails parameters={undefined}></ParamsDetails>
